shots.p: wide shot of the city of Mecca nestled among dry mountains at dawn, the sacred house in the valley, tranquil
aerial shot of Mecca's valley in daylight, peaceful streets and mountains, a sense of honor and safety
wide shot of a large multi-generation family, grandfather, parents and children, gathered in a courtyard, generations continuing
medium shot of a laborer in a long robe struggling to push a heavy cart up a rocky slope under a hot sun
medium shot of a rich arrogant man counting chests of gold in his hall, smirking confidently
medium shot of the same rich man boasting to a crowd, scattering coins carelessly in a grand hall
close-up of the boasting rich man glancing around as if no one sees him, a vast sky visible through the window behind
extreme close-up of two human eyes reflecting a bright sunrise, gift of sight
close-up of a man's calm face speaking, lips gently parted, soft light, gift of speech, modest framing
wide shot of two diverging paths in a valley: one bright and climbing toward sunlight, one dark descending into shadow
wide shot of a steep rugged mountain pass rising steeply, difficult and rocky, a narrow trail upward
low angle on the same steep mountain pass shrouded in mist, daunting and unknown
close-up of hands unlocking heavy iron shackles from a freed man's wrists, his face full of relief
medium shot of a man handing bread to hungry people during a famine in a dusty village
medium shot of a man tenderly feeding a young orphan relative at a simple table, warm lamplight
medium shot of a poor man sitting in the dust beside a road receiving food from a kind passerby
wide shot of believers gently encouraging one another, one placing a comforting hand on another's shoulder, warm sunset
wide shot of a group of righteous people walking together on a bright path on the right side toward a green valley
wide shot of a group of people walking on a dark path on the left side toward ominous storm clouds
close-up of a massive iron gate slammed shut against a red glowing furnace light, sealed with no way out
